values.note: One night with water and electric, with or without sewer, $40; tents $25 (an extra family tent $15). Rate covers one immediate family; other guests $5 per adult and $2.50 per child a night. July promotion $30 a night. Cards carry a 3% surcharge. Seasonal sites $1,500 plus electric; extended seasonal $2,200.

note: Private campground about 3.5 miles west of Minong on WI-77 with a wading creek, walking trails, a pickleball court and a fish-cleaning house; Bass Lake's beach is 1.5 miles away. Showers cost $2 and open only on weekend mornings and evenings. ATV/UTV trails start at the campground's back entrance. --Claude
summary: Operator site read (home, rates, rules). 50 sites (41 full hookup, 6 W/E, 2 tent), $40 a night W/E or full hookup, phone reservations, open about Apr 15 - Oct 15. Posts seasonal rates but gives no seasonal/nightly split. Google 3.8 (62): DROP CANDIDATE under the private-park review rule. ATV trails start at the campground: OHV flag.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (Google): 3.8 stars from 62 reviews, under 4.0 with 25+ reviews. Review texts did not load (only the topic chips: 'friendly owners' 13, 'quiet campground' 7, 'atv trails' 4).

OHV (flag): the operator markets 'ATV/UTV Trails - Accessible right from our back entrance' and its rules say 'Guests may use the campground trails, which begin near the bunkhouse and extend into the back campground area'. A private park marketing ATV trails starting at the campground; reviewer decides.

LONG-STAY (unmeasured): seasonal sites are sold ('Seasonal Sites ... $1,500', 'Extended Seasonal Stay $2,200', winter storage $200) and full-hookup guests are asked to use their RV showers, but no page gives how many of the 41 full-hookup sites are seasonal. A nightly rate ($40) is posted and nightly guests are welcomed (July $10-off promotion), so tests 1-2 pass; nightly share could not be measured.
SHOWERS: $2 a use and open only 8-10:30 am and 5-8 pm Friday evening through Sunday morning (rules page): noted in the note.
PHONE 715-829-3100 confirmed; second line 715-829-9986. WEBSITE confirmed. Not waterfront confirmed (a small creek on the property for wading).
